﻿Just candidates already living in Malta will be contacted
 Job Description
 The shift starts at 5:00 AM, so we would prefer candidates who live close to the property or have reliable transportation for the early start 
 We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Public Area Attendant to join our housekeeping team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, presentation, and hygiene of all public areas within the hotel, ensuring guests enjoy a clean, safe, and welcoming environment.
 Key Responsibilities
 Clean and maintain all public areas, including the lobby, corridors, elevators, restrooms, reception, and other guest facilities.
 Sweep, mop, vacuum, dust, and polish floors, furniture, and surfaces.
 Replenish restroom supplies and ensure all facilities are clean and fully stocked.
 Empty rubbish bins and dispose of waste according to hotel procedures.
 Report maintenance issues, damages, or safety hazards to the appropriate department.
 Follow hotel health, safety, and hygiene standards at all times.
 Assist the housekeeping team with additional cleaning tasks when required.
 Ensure cleaning equipment and supplies are used and stored correctly.
 Provide friendly and professional service when interacting with guests.
 Requirements
 Pre-departure course is mandatory
 The shift starts at 5:00 AM, so we would prefer candidates who live close to the property or have reliable transportation for the early start
 Previous experience in housekeeping or a similar cleaning role is preferred but not essential.
 Good attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Physically fit and able to perform manual tasks.
 Basic English communication skills.
 Flexibility to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
 What We Offer
 Competitive salary.
 Full training provided.
 Opportunities for career growth within the hotel.
 Friendly and supportive working environment.
 Staff meals during shifts (where applicable).
